parts.html: The K-08 standard model is a minimalist straight kitchen in brown tones, where an expressive wood texture meets clean geometry and modern furniture hardware.
The wood-effect decor makes the kitchen feel warm without overwhelming it and pairs well with light walls, stone, and neutral flooring.
The main feature of the K-08 is that all the fronts, upper and lower, are made of HPL-faced MDF panels in the same wood decor, so the kitchen looks cohesive.
All the furniture runs along one wall, leaving room for a dining table. At 4.2 linear meters, the kitchen suits an apartment, a studio, or a private house.
The upper cabinets open upward on FREE SPACE Hafele lift-up mechanisms, and the doors close smoothly on Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges.
Hinges: Muller Profi Line with soft-close mechanisms
We will make the K-08 to fit your kitchen’s dimensions, utility connections, and built-in appliances — with delivery and installation in Bratislava and Vienna.
